test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 16 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4' **i.e. **'Productive'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• The correct option to fill in blank number 4 is **"productive".**
 
• In this context,** "Productive"** means yielding positive or useful results.
 
• This is the ideal choice as it **aligns with the context **of the sentence that is trying to differentiate between positive/productive and detrimental uses of social media.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *Social media platforms and many people on them have their own agendas and they are often trying to sell you things. So, be aware of how much time and energy you give to sellers and users and think about what they want from you when engaging. To gauge which uses are positive and **productive** and which are detrimental, ask yourself simply, when does using social media make me feel good or bad, and why? Do I (5) ______use it all of the time?*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at why the other options are not correct:
 
 
• **"Pliable" **- This means easily bent or flexible. In this context, it doesn't fit because the sentence is not talking about flexibility but about the positive or useful results of using social media.
 
• **"Possessive" **- This means demanding someone’s total attention and love. This does not fit the context here as the sentence is about evaluating the outcomes of using social media, not about demanding attention or love.
 
• **"Punitive" **- This means inflicting or intended as punishment. This does not fit the context of the sentence, which is about differentiating between the positive and negative aspects of using social media, not about punishment.
